**Archmage response: the ARC-106 question**

I re-read my full source (ARC-101 to ARC-116) and the leyline CSV was not needed for these questions. I answer from the letters only.

**(1) Did any message from my office reach the Engineer or the hulpslag team?**
No. ARC-106 (dag 8) is addressed "Aan de datatoren buiten de burchtmuur," the signal tower, not to the Engineer or the hulpslag team. My source records no channel of delivery. Nothing in ARC-101, ARC-102, ARC-103, ARC-104, ARC-105, ARC-107, ARC-108, ARC-109, ARC-110, ARC-111, ARC-112, ARC-113, ARC-114, ARC-115, or ARC-116 mentions the Engineer, the hulpslag, or any activation. I cannot say whether the Engineer ever saw ARC-106.

**(2) Who was the "hogerhand"?**
No record names one. ARC-106 is signed by me, "de Archmage," and cites no higher authority. I cannot identify any "hogerhand" in ARC-101 to ARC-116. I need to correct my earlier framing: the approval in ARC-106 was given by my own office, not relayed from above. The phrase "Niet ruchtbaar maken tot het draait" appears in both ARC-106 and ENG-105. That is a wording match only. ARC-106 is addressed to the tower and the Engineer is not named in it.

**(3) Did my office know of the hulpslag activation on dag 10 at 02:40?**
Not from my source. No ARC record mentions the hulpslag, ENG-011, or a pulse activation. ARC-106 permits the net to run "op eigen maat," which is a general permission. It does not describe a specific activation, so I cannot claim knowledge of ENG-011. I also have no record of the dag 9 proefopstelling at 16:45 (ENG-010). ARC-107 (dag 9) concerns lamp oil and the door lock only.

**What this means**
- ARC-106 is an off-register permission from my office for the tower's net. I took responsibility for it in my earlier message, and I maintain that.
- It is not established that ARC-106 is the approval the Engineer recorded in ENG-105. The Engineer cannot confirm the link either, so the approver remains unidentified.
- ARC-106 says "op eigen maat," and ENG-011 says "eigen pols." Both describe the net running on its own timing. This is a textual parallel, not evidence of a link.
- The Engineer's "hogerhand" cannot be identified from my records, and I will not claim it is me or anyone else.

**Requests:** I still need the raw per-line leyline logs for days 8 to 10 and days 21 to 23. I also need to see ENG-105 and ENG-011 directly, to check whether they were written after ARC-106.
